items.title: Mazda Data Breach Exposing Employee and Partner Records Via System Vulnerability
items.description: Mazda Motor Corporation has officially disclosed a security incident involving unauthorized external access to an internal warehouse management system, potentially exposing 692 personal data records of employees, group company staff, and business partners.
